description: Publication-page representative images rendered from reviewed regions of the archived paper PDFs. Every region is a complete figure or a complete sub-image of one, showing the paper's own results (or, for surveys and evaluations, clearly attributed examples); nothing is synthetic and nothing is cropped to fill the frame.

layouts.pack: regions are laid out in the listed rows, each row justified to the same width, then the block is fitted into the canvas on white
layouts.contain: one region (usually a diagram) is fitted into the canvas on the figure's own background colour

coordinates: rows[][].rect is [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the PDF page given by rows[][].page (1-based)
